title: Yolanda-hit Guiuan hospital reopens after 13 years

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Thirteen years after Super Typhoon Yolanda (international name: Haiyan) devastated Eastern Samar, the Felipe Abrigo Memorial Hospital (FAMH) reopened on Oct. 7, restoring public hospital services for residents of Guiuan and neighboring municipalities. Located in Barangay 9A, the hospital marks a step toward rebuilding health care services in Guiuan, one of the areas hardest hit when Yolanda made landfall on Nov. 8, 2013. The rehabilitated Level 1 district hospital initially has 25 beds, with plans to expand its capacity to 50, and is expected to reduce the need for patients to travel long distances for treatment.
